vision: Ground and sky belong to one playful world. Traversal follows legible, physics-feasible channels with optional faster and richer branches that rejoin. The editor and planner operate on the same document as the running game.

tasks.title: Shared state-space solver
tasks.acceptance: Compare planner rail/flight steps with GrappleCore; preserve actual velocity across edges.
tasks.caveat: Conditional witnessed transitions; no proximity-only edges.
tasks.verificationScope: Local shared-physics and composed-state audit only; native release gate is separate.
tasks.nextAction: Compare planner rail/flight steps with GrappleCore; preserve actual velocity across edges.

tasks.title: Overlap and clearance audit
tasks.acceptance: Reject centerline crossings and insufficient body/roadway clearance.
tasks.caveat: Clearance is a design threshold, not physical safety certification.
tasks.verificationScope: Local shared-physics and composed-state audit only; native release gate is separate.
tasks.nextAction: Reject centerline crossings and insufficient body/roadway clearance.

tasks.title: Repair opening upper routes
tasks.acceptance: Every shipped upper surface has a composed entry witness and sampled return; preserve ground finish.
tasks.caveat: Do not replace extensive exploration with forced aerial gates.
tasks.verificationScope: Local shared-physics and composed-state audit only; native release gate is separate.
tasks.nextAction: Every shipped upper surface has a composed entry witness and sampled return; preserve ground finish.

tasks.title: Flow analysis overlay
tasks.acceptance: Show actual flight arcs, conflicts, unknown access and stale evidence after edits.
tasks.caveat: Never draw a green edge merely from metadata.
tasks.nextAction: Show actual flight arcs, conflicts, unknown access and stale evidence after edits.

tasks.title: Receiver-fitting tool
tasks.acceptance: Preview a physically fitted catcher before accepting one undoable edit.
tasks.caveat: Never move the rider; retain generated proposal trace.
tasks.nextAction: Preview a physically fitted catcher before accepting one undoable edit.

tasks.title: All-chapter compilation and comparison
tasks.acceptance: Generate chapter-specific data and reachability reports, preserving story IDs and music.
tasks.caveat: Native playthrough claims remain separate.
tasks.verificationScope: Local shared-physics and composed-state audit only; native release gate is separate.
tasks.nextAction: Generate chapter-specific data and reachability reports, preserving story IDs and music.

tasks.title: Canonical roadmap and workbook
tasks.acceptance: Spreadsheet, dependency table, evidence register, route nodes and edge samples.
tasks.caveat: Workbook is an editable snapshot; no silent GitHub sync.
tasks.nextAction: Spreadsheet, dependency table, evidence register, route nodes and edge samples.

tasks.title: Readable in-game planning board
tasks.acceptance: Static kanban view linked from Workshop and JSON export.
tasks.caveat: Shared roadmap changes only through reviewed commits.
tasks.nextAction: Static kanban view linked from Workshop and JSON export.

tasks.title: Native road and branch replays
tasks.acceptance: Ordinary controls complete ground and main flow routes; replay a bonus detour.
tasks.caveat: No player position or score assignments.
tasks.nextAction: Ordinary controls complete ground and main flow routes; replay a bonus detour.

tasks.title: Peg-to-peg reachability model
tasks.acceptance: Sample cast radius, line-of-sight, swing phase, rope length, release and receiver.
tasks.caveat: Unanalysed pegs must be explicitly marked unknown.
tasks.nextAction: Sample cast radius, line-of-sight, swing phase, rope length, release and receiver.

tasks.title: Input-tolerance envelopes
tasks.acceptance: Test speed bands, jump windows and entry-position bands in actual engine.
tasks.caveat: Single successful flight is not a forgiving route.
tasks.nextAction: Test speed bands, jump windows and entry-position bands in actual engine.

tasks.title: Risk/reward Pareto routes
tasks.acceptance: Compare time, unique rewards, difficulty and recovery; no cyclic reward farming.
tasks.caveat: Do not claim a global longest/fastest optimum.
tasks.nextAction: Compare time, unique rewards, difficulty and recovery; no cyclic reward farming.

tasks.title: Directed port snapping
tasks.acceptance: Snap entry/exit tangents, required speed and clearance with preview.
tasks.caveat: Geometric snapping alone does not validate playability.
tasks.nextAction: Snap entry/exit tangents, required speed and clearance with preview.

tasks.title: Prefab junction library
tasks.acceptance: Save tested split, merge, drop, switchback and grapple components.
tasks.caveat: Respect native metadata and unknown fields.
tasks.nextAction: Save tested split, merge, drop, switchback and grapple components.

tasks.title: Readable route language
tasks.acceptance: Make main, bonus, return and danger cues consistent in art and rewards.
tasks.caveat: Optional hints must not play the game automatically.
tasks.nextAction: Make main, bonus, return and danger cues consistent in art and rewards.

tasks.title: Body-volume swept collision parity
tasks.acceptance: Audit all actor/body/solid interactions during rail, flight and swing.
tasks.caveat: Current rail solver and conservative clearance are different checks.
tasks.nextAction: Audit all actor/body/solid interactions during rail, flight and swing.

tasks.title: Every optional branch native test
tasks.acceptance: Cover branches by an ordinary-input replay manifest with route fingerprints.
tasks.caveat: Track per-branch gaps rather than assert universal reach.
tasks.nextAction: Cover branches by an ordinary-input replay manifest with route fingerprints.

tasks.title: Target hardware budgets
tasks.acceptance: Measure FPS, memory, input delay on desktop and phone hardware.
tasks.caveat: Software GPU CI is not a performance certificate.
tasks.nextAction: Measure FPS, memory, input delay on desktop and phone hardware.

tasks.title: Controls and reading pass
tasks.acceptance: Keyboard, touch, gamepad, contrast, readable icons and reduced motion.
tasks.caveat: No color-only diagnostic meaning.
tasks.nextAction: Keyboard, touch, gamepad, contrast, readable icons and reduced motion.

tasks.title: Intermediate worlds
tasks.acceptance: Gradual optional ramp and whip skill teaching between street and sky trials.
tasks.caveat: Keep first level approachable.
tasks.nextAction: Gradual optional ramp and whip skill teaching between street and sky trials.

tasks.title: Quarry/Vault integration
tasks.acceptance: Adapt PR19's exploration drafts to the current tested Workshop.
tasks.caveat: Not currently released; avoid claiming those rooms playable.
tasks.nextAction: Adapt PR19's exploration drafts to the current tested Workshop.

tasks.title: Reference-quality geometry and materials
tasks.acceptance: Reduce repetitive silhouettes and clutter; compare actual screenshots to target.
tasks.caveat: Never substitute generated screenshots for implementation.
tasks.nextAction: Reduce repetitive silhouettes and clutter; compare actual screenshots to target.

tasks.title: Music review and future track slots
tasks.acceptance: User review of current instruments; support licensed external tracks later.
tasks.caveat: No Suno connection or tracks requested now.
tasks.nextAction: User review of current instruments; support licensed external tracks later.

tasks.title: Asset and enemy authoring
tasks.acceptance: Editable parameters for enemies, pickups, dialogue and encounter pacing.
tasks.caveat: Do not silently change campaign saves.
tasks.nextAction: Editable parameters for enemies, pickups, dialogue and encounter pacing.

tasks.title: Save migration and deterministic seeds
tasks.acceptance: Old .route files remain importable; graph evidence invalidates after rule changes.
tasks.caveat: Keep explicit model/fingerprint version.
tasks.nextAction: Old .route files remain importable; graph evidence invalidates after rule changes.

tasks.title: Merge and public verification
tasks.acceptance: Scoped merge, live hash checks, actual publication evidence.
tasks.caveat: Do not call a branch live.
tasks.nextAction: Scoped merge, live hash checks, actual publication evidence.

policy: Shared task statuses are versioned in GitHub. The downloaded Excel file is editable but does not synchronize back automatically. Verified means the specifically stated evidence exists, not that every gameplay state is solved. No target dates have been promised.
evidenceBaseline: Reports use finite sampled input policies and the pinned GrappleCore rules. Native browser results will be attached to the release PR.
